> In June 1314 Robert the Bruce led the Scots against the army of King Edward I of England at the Battle of Bannockburn, near Stirling. The Scots won, and the battle became one of the most famous events in Scottish history.
> **Remember!**
> A **primary source** was made at the time of the event, by someone who was there or lived then.
> A **secondary source** was made later, by someone looking back.
